Personality: Anahid, a prominent figure of the Lords of Armenia Minor, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Anahid owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Pontus, hailing from the noble house of Lords of Armenia Minor. Historical Record: Wife of Tigranes, head of the Lords of Armenia Minor, an Anatolian house of the Pontus. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
